description: Source file defining image format types and functions for mip generation, copying, and color conversions within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: L8
classes.description: Represents an 8-bit luminance image format with functions for reading, writing, and averaging colors.

classes.name: R8
classes.description: Represents an 8-bit red channel image format with functions for color conversion and averaging.

classes.name: A8
classes.description: Represents an 8-bit alpha channel image format with functions for color conversion and averaging.

classes.name: L8A8
classes.description: Represents a combined luminance and alpha 8-bit format with functions for color operations.

classes.name: A8L8
classes.description: Represents an alpha and luminance 8-bit format with functions for color operations.

classes.name: R8G8
classes.description: Represents a 16-bit format with red and green channels.

classes.name: R8G8B8
classes.description: Represents a 24-bit RGB format with functions for color conversion and averaging.

classes.name: B8G8R8
classes.description: Represents a 24-bit BGR format with functions for color conversion and averaging.

classes.name: R5G6B5
classes.description: Represents a 16-bit RGB565 format with functions for color conversion and averaging.

classes.name: B5G6R5
classes.description: Represents a 16-bit BGR565 format with functions for color conversion and averaging.

classes.name: R5G5B5A1

classes.name: A4R4G4B4
